ordering: Items are in execution order for the voice-to-durable-knowledge core loop. Each item records dated aggregate evidence, dependencies, authority, and its next action; later items do not imply approval to skip an earlier gate.

items.title: Establish measurement attribution and reconciliation
items.problem: The August 17 aggregate baseline mixes internal and external traffic, has uneven event versions and surface coverage, and conflicts with durable-recording counts; it cannot support a decision-grade activation or processing conclusion.

evidence.evidence_strength: operator-observed, unretained private aggregate snapshot; repository assertion, not independently reproducible production evidence
evidence.reconciliation_status: events and durable recordings remain unreconciled
evidence.cohort_status: internal and external attribution is not yet available
evidence.readiness_audit: distribution and internal-user attribution must be paired with a validated first-party recording link; historical rows remain legacy_unattributed

items.hypothesis: Traceable cohort attribution and event-to-durable-recording reconciliation will make activation and processing outcomes interpretable without exposing content or identifiers.
items.primary_metric: share of processing outcomes with attributed cohort and reconciled durable-recording evidence
items.guardrail: no raw user or session identifiers or content in reports or analytics
items.authority: Agents may establish measurement and documentation within the approved slice; no provider, pricing, limit, onboarding, or App Store change is authorized.
items.next_action: Production rollout remains blocked, the one-use preview approval is consumed, and no retry is authorized. Discuss with Mike and obtain his explicit build decision before replacing the hosted db test --db-url path with a non-billable structured-JSON contract executor over the already-working database-query transport. Before any hosted or production use, cross-check that executor locally against the existing 21-, 30-, and 7-assertion pgTAP contracts on passing and deliberately failing fixtures.

items.title: Make evaluation honest and preserve immutable lineage
items.problem: The extraction evaluator self-copies expected output when predictions are absent, and processed records lack immutable transcription/extraction input, output, model, prompt, and stage lineage.

evidence.evaluation_status: self-copied expected output is not an independent quality result
evidence.lineage_status: exact model identifiers and prompt hashes are not persisted
evidence.dependency_status: Runtime work remains blocked on the incomplete TL-DATA-001 hosted rollout.

items.hypothesis: Independent predictions and immutable lineage will make quality, reliability, latency, cost, canary, and rollback gates auditable.
items.primary_metric: share of evaluation results with independent predictions and complete immutable lineage
items.guardrail: no raw audio, transcripts, prompts, note text, feedback text, or identifiers in tracked evaluation artifacts
items.authority: Agents may implement evaluation and lineage evidence within an approved reversible slice; provider or base-model changes remain Mike-approved.
items.next_action: Runtime work remains blocked. Begin only after TL-DATA-001 Task 6 has dated verified migration/API rollout evidence and passing canaries; then freeze the shared current-control inference contract without behavior change and build the honest private audio-manifest and independent-prediction path.

items.title: Evaluate the transcription challenger against the current control
items.problem: The current transcription control has not been compared through an honest audio-to-task corpus with independent outputs, quality, reliability, latency, and cost evidence.

evidence.candidate_scope: in-provider comparison only; broader provider candidates remain future evidence

items.hypothesis: An honest audio-to-task comparison can determine whether the immediate challenger improves the declared tradeoff without changing production prematurely.
items.primary_metric: challenger versus control result on the honest audio-to-task corpus
items.guardrail: critical transcription errors, processing reliability, latency, cost, and no exposure of corpus content
items.authority: Agents may run the offline comparison after TL-EVAL-001; any production base-model or provider change requires Mike's explicit approval.
items.next_action: Run Groq whisper-large-v3 against Groq whisper-large-v3-turbo on the honest audio-to-task corpus; record the result without changing production.

items.title: Define the extraction contract and measure missed actions
items.problem: Extraction has no versioned correctness contract or trustworthy measure of unsupported and missed action items.

evidence.control: Groq openai/gpt-oss-120b with JSON-object response mode in local source
evidence.quality_gap: current evaluator is not independent and missed actions are not canonically measured

items.funnel_step: transcription -> structured note and to-dos -> recording_processed
items.hypothesis: A versioned extraction contract with independent scoring will make missed and unsupported actions visible before any candidate is promoted.
items.primary_metric: missed-action rate and unsupported-action rate on independent evaluation predictions
items.guardrail: schema validity, critical meaning errors, latency, cost, and no content in tracked artifacts
items.authority: Agents may define and evaluate prompt, schema, and normalizer candidates within an approved reversible slice; any base-model change requires Mike's explicit approval.
items.next_action: Publish the versioned contract and independent scorer, then baseline missed and unsupported actions against the declared control.

items.title: Build agentic feedback learning with safe promotion gates
items.problem: Feedback is stored but not consumed through validated, deduplicated, classified, quarantined, and traceable candidate-generation stages.

evidence.coverage_gap: deduplication, classification, quarantine, and promotion evidence are not implemented
evidence.policy: ambiguous labels remain quarantined and are excluded from promotion evidence

items.funnel_step: user review -> feedback intake -> candidate evaluation -> reversible canary
items.hypothesis: Automating safe feedback handling will create usable learning signals while keeping the recording user as the only evaluator and preserving trust.
items.primary_metric: eligible, deduplicated, classified feedback-signal rate with complete lineage
items.guardrail: quarantine ambiguous labels; no raw feedback or user content in artifacts; no blind online self-training
items.authority: Agents may implement routine reversible learning controls within an approved slice; a data-use-policy, provider, or base-model change requires Mike's explicit approval.
items.next_action: Instrument aggregate validation, deduplication, classification, quarantine, and candidate-lineage outcomes before any promotion path is enabled.

items.title: Make the account handoff continue the demo's value
items.problem: The account screen replaces the concrete note a user just created with a generic email-and-password form, a disabled primary action, and a confirmation-email warning.

evidence.founder_test: The live onboarding felt too privacy-heavy before value and the generic email form did not make the captured note feel worth saving.
evidence.implementation_status: Value-led copy, deferred privacy links, and Apple, Google, and email entry points shipped in version 1.0.3.

items.hypothesis: Carrying the generated note into a value-led account handoff and offering native Sign in with Apple will increase account attempts and completed authentication.
items.primary_metric: auth_started sessions / auth screen viewed sessions
items.guardrail: auth failure rate and demo recording completion rate
items.authority: Mike approval is required for product/design direction; agents may measure the shipped flow.
items.next_action: Measure auth_started, auth_succeeded, and auth_failed by provider as new signed-in traffic arrives.

items.title: Brand the OAuth sign-in domain
items.problem: The iOS authentication handoff names the raw Supabase project hostname, which makes a legitimate Throughline sign-in look unpolished and unfamiliar.

evidence.observed_prompt: Throughline wants to use the Supabase project hostname to sign in
evidence.priority: backlog; production callback reliability is the immediate requirement

items.hypothesis: A branded authentication domain will improve trust at the provider handoff without changing the underlying Supabase authentication flow.
items.guardrail: Google and Apple callback success rate
items.authority: Mike approval is required because this changes provider-facing authentication configuration and product trust surface.
items.next_action: Choose a Throughline-owned domain, configure a Supabase custom auth domain such as auth.throughline.example, and update Google and Apple callback registrations before changing the app base URL.

items.title: Turn extracted todos into a dependable task home
items.problem: Throughline extracts task dates, priorities, context and completion state, but the app does not yet present a task inbox, Today/Upcoming/Completed views, reminders, or clear source-note traceability.

evidence.source: outside-in product study and current iOS implementation
evidence.market_pattern: Successful task products organize work by time and status; voice-workflow users ask for dated tasks that route into daily systems.
evidence.sample_size_warning: Competitive and qualitative evidence only; validate with activated users.

items.hypothesis: A time-based task home with source-note traceability will turn one-off voice capture into a repeatable daily workflow.
items.primary_metric: new activated users who revisit or complete an extracted task within 7 days
items.guardrail: task extraction correction rate and reminder opt-out rate
items.authority: Mike approval is required for product/design direction before implementation.
items.next_action: Mock Today, Upcoming and Completed views plus the task-to-source-note interaction, then wait for approval before implementation.

items.title: Make every recording recoverable
items.problem: Recordings are created in temporary storage and the current app has no durable outbox or retry control after an upload failure.

evidence.implementation_observation: A failed upload surfaces an error, but the user cannot replay or retry the captured file from the UI.

items.hypothesis: Persisting recordings locally until confirmed and exposing an automatic/manual retry path will reduce lost-thought failures and increase trust.
items.guardrail: local storage growth and duplicate upload rate
items.authority: Mike approval is required for product/design direction before implementation.
items.next_action: Mock pending, failed, replay and retry outbox states before implementation.

items.title: Expose the voice knowledge layer
items.problem: Throughline extracts tags, people and projects, but the iOS surface is chronological and does not expose library search, entity pages, related notes or backlinks.

evidence.source: outside-in product study and current iOS implementation
evidence.market_pattern: Obsidian and Reflect establish search, structured properties and links as the durable knowledge-system layer.

items.funnel_step: note saved -> note retrieved -> note reused
items.hypothesis: Search and entity-based retrieval will make old voice memories useful after the day they were captured.
items.primary_metric: activated users who retrieve and open a note older than 7 days
items.guardrail: search abandonment rate and manual metadata correction rate
items.authority: Mike approval is required for product/design direction before implementation.
items.next_action: Gather direct retrieval jobs from the first activated users, then mock Library search and one entity page before choosing backlinks or graph UI.

items.title: Make agent connection guided and permissioned
items.problem: Throughline MCP setup requires copying a token and command, and the agent can read but cannot perform auditable user-approved actions such as completing a task or appending to a note.

evidence.source: outside-in product study and current MCP implementation
evidence.market_pattern: Voicenotes offers browser OAuth and note creation; Reflect offers note editing and checkbox toggles through MCP.

items.funnel_step: agent connection viewed -> agent connected -> agent-assisted action
items.hypothesis: A guided connection with explicit read and write scopes will increase successful agent setup while preserving trust.
items.primary_metric: signed-in users who successfully complete a first MCP tool call
items.guardrail: token revocation rate and unauthorized-action reports
items.authority: Mike approval is required for product/design direction and any new agent write capability.
items.next_action: Interview early MCP users about their first desired write action, then define scopes and mock the authorization flow.

items.title: Automate the weekly evidence pull
items.problem: Product usage and feedback exist in separate surfaces, which makes a consistent weekly decision review easy to skip.

evidence.evidence_strength: operator-observed, unretained private aggregate snapshot; repository assertion, not independently reproducible production evidence
evidence.reconciliation_status: durable feedback rows and feedback_submitted event history remain unreconciled

items.hypothesis: A deterministic private report will make each review repeatable and keep low-volume data from being overinterpreted.
items.guardrail: feedback excerpts remain local and git-ignored
items.authority: Agents may maintain the privacy-safe evidence pull and its documentation.
items.next_action: Review the report format, then schedule it at the preferred weekly cadence.

items.title: Make feedback submission unmistakable and complete
items.problem: The feedback form stores submissions correctly, but its send action was below the scroll and keyboard while the visible navigation action only closed the form.

evidence.source: founder production test and iOS implementation audit
evidence.implementation_status: A persistent Send feedback action, keyboard dismissal, success confirmation, and privacy-safe failure event are implemented locally.

items.hypothesis: Keeping the primary send action visible will turn feedback intent into completed submissions without adding an interruptive prompt.
items.guardrail: feedback_submit_failed rate and no feedback text in analytics
items.authority: Agents may verify and measure the implemented feedback flow; changes to data-use policy remain Mike-approved.
items.next_action: Include the completed feedback flow in the next app release and confirm the first real submission appears in the private product report.

items.title: Measure AI cost per successful recording
items.problem: Throughline uses Groq for transcription and structured extraction, but it does not yet persist provider usage and estimated cost per processing stage.

evidence.measurement_status: request success and latency are observable; token, audio-duration, retry, and estimated-cost reporting are not yet canonical

items.hypothesis: Recording stage-level usage and applying a versioned price table will make gross margin and premium limits measurable before monetization.
items.guardrail: no recordings, transcripts, prompts, note content, or provider keys in analytics
items.authority: Agents may build measurement within an approved slice; provider and pricing changes remain Mike-approved.
items.next_action: Persist model, stage, audio duration, input/output tokens, retry count, latency, and estimated USD cost; report totals and p50/p95 cost per successful recording.

items.title: Offer longer voice notes with a premium subscription
items.problem: The free app currently caps a recording at five minutes, while higher-intent users may value longer capture sessions enough to support a paid plan.

evidence.priority: backlog-only; premium limits up to 15 minutes are not an implementation commitment until usage and cost baselines are decision-grade

items.funnel_step: recording limit reached -> premium offer -> longer recording processed
items.hypothesis: A premium plan with longer recordings will monetize high-intent capture without weakening the useful free experience.
items.primary_metric: eligible users who start and retain a premium subscription
items.guardrail: free activation, recording completion, refund rate, and AI cost per premium recording
items.authority: Mike's explicit approval is required for pricing, recording limits, subscriptions, and implementation.
items.next_action: Keep premium duration, pricing, and entitlement design in evidence/backlog only; revisit only after cost, activation, and retention baselines are decision-grade.

items.title: Evaluate recording-time credits only after quality and cost evidence
items.problem: Evaluation credits, their exchange rate, earning cap, expiry, and accounting controls are not supported by decision-grade quality, usage, or cost evidence.

evidence.status: backlog-only; not a program milestone or implementation commitment
evidence.open_questions: credit-to-seconds exchange rate, earning cap, expiry, fraud controls, and cost impact

items.funnel_step: valid evaluation or correction -> possible earned recording time
items.hypothesis: If future evidence supports it, non-transferable credits for a valid evaluation or correction could reward contribution without rewarding sentiment.
items.primary_metric: decision-grade evidence for quality contribution, cost, and abuse resistance
items.guardrail: no implementation, no credit accounting, no raw evaluation content, and no reward tied to sentiment or score
items.authority: Mike's explicit approval is required for pricing, recording limits, credits, and implementation.
items.next_action: Keep credits in evidence/backlog state until evaluation integrity, quality, cost, and abuse controls have decision-grade evidence.
